svg.title: PractiSQL request and execution flow
svg.desc: A question becomes scoped context, model output, local SQLite execution and actual result history. Privacy and verification boundaries remain explicit.

g.text: From a question to SQL. From actual results to learning.
Saved results and operation provenance inform the next question.
SQLite runs on the device. AI is optional.
Selected context and observations can go to your provider.
Lessons, challenges, exams and data projects.
Execution success is evidence of an executed query, not a guarantee of every explanation or business interpretation.
